title: Bennett’s Bridge — Former Freedom Mill Adaptive Reuse
size: Existing former Freedom Mill commercial/entertainment property at 2730 Spot Road; final renovation square footage and construction value not yet publicly disclosed
timing: Forsyth County commissioners approved the zoning amendment in September 2026 to convert the vacant former Freedom Mill property into a residential and community program for adults with special needs. This is an early contractor-positioning opportunity: monitor county permitting and identify the project architect/GC before renovation packages are committed. Likely work includes code/accessibility upgrades, MEP modernization, fire/life-safety, interiors, low voltage and site improvements.
source: North Atlanta Star — September 12, 2026 development report

title: Roper Park — New Aquatic Center & Park Improvements
size: Approximately $4 million conceptual public aquatic-center and park-improvement program at 1262 East Church Street
timing: The CM-at-Risk procurement is listed with a September 11, 2026 bid date and an anticipated November 10 construction start. The prime pursuit window has closed, so local specialty contractors should track the CMAR award and approach the selected construction manager for aquatic systems, concrete, MEP, site/civil, landscaping, paving and recreation-equipment packages.
